verdicts.reason: A breaks the original motif: the can is pulled to the left away from its olive circle, so the circle ends up as a stray shape behind the quote text and logo. The quote mark floats far above its quote with a big gap, and the right column is cramped while the left side is mostly empty. B keeps the original structure: the quote mark, quote and attribution form one tight left column, the logo sits bottom-left, and the can stays on its circle at the right. Its flaws are minor: the attribution and the SOLSTICE label are very small at this size, the can floats a little high on the circle's edge, and the upper right is somewhat empty.
